items.escena: A patch of clay forest and wetland ringed by a low boundary marker, with a small ranger post at its gate
A small clay field station with a flag pole, a parked truck and two ranger figures studying a map on its porch
A heavy clay law book resting closed on a plinth, with a small clay tree and a clay balance scale beside it
A clay landscape modelled in three concentric rings: dense untouched forest at the centre, lighter woodland around it and farmed fields on the outer ring
Two clay forest patches joined by a narrow green strip of trees, with a small clay jaguar walking along it
A gullied bare clay slope on one side and the same slope terraced and planted with saplings on the other, clay hands setting one in the soil
A clay figure sitting up on the edge of a bed with feet on the floor, a small alarm clock on the nightstand
Four clay jars in a row, filled to four clearly different levels from brimming to empty
A clay figure seated at a small table with a bowl, a cup and a piece of bread in front of it
A clay figure at a desk bent over an open notebook with a pencil, a school bag on the floor beside the chair
A clay calendar block with five identical tiles in a row and two larger tiles set apart at the end
Three clay figures in a row, the third one stepping forward slightly ahead of the other two
A clay computer with its case open and four small clay keys laid out in a row beside it
A clay scroll unrolled beside a small clay machine, its surface modelled as fine ruled lines of raised texture
A clay penguin figure standing beside a small clay gnu, both on a plain plinth in front of a desktop computer
A clay padlock lying open on a table with its shackle raised, a small clay key resting beside it
Three small clay documents standing in a row on a desk: a page of ruled lines, a grid sheet and a slide board on a stand
A clay wardrobe rail with three shirts above four pairs of trousers, thin clay threads linking every shirt to every pair
A descending clay staircase where each step holds one fewer bead than the step before it
Three clay medals on a podium with three small figures being placed in a specific first, second and third order
A clay bowl holding three chosen beads together in a loose heap, no order to them
Two clay bags side by side, a hand returning a bead into one while another hand sets a bead aside from the other
Six clay beads in a row, one lifted slightly and marked by a small clay pointer above it
A clay bus terminal hall with a signpost whose blank arms point down three different corridors
A large round clay station clock on a wall above a row of waiting benches
Three clay objects in a row on a counter: a small clock, a single calendar day tile and a thick calendar block
Two clay buildings touching side by side and a third one standing a short distance away across a small plaza
A clay car parked on the street directly before a clay house, with a small shed just visible behind the house
A clay traveller with a suitcase raising an open hand toward a clay information clerk behind a counter
A clay waterfall pouring onto a small clay wheel that turns, spray rising at its base
A clay workbench with a small motor, a lamp and a gear assembly wired together into one working device
A clay boiler with a fire beneath it, its steam pushing a piston that turns a chunky flywheel
A clay hand crank turning a coil between two magnets, a small clay bulb glowing on the wires beside it
A clay question-mark sculpture standing on a lab bench beside a beaker and a notebook
A clay note card propped against a beaker on a bench, with a small balance scale standing behind it
A clay bar chart of five blocks of different heights standing on a desk beside a small tidy table of tiles
A small clay scoop of beads on one side and a large bowl of beads on the other, with a clay arrow curving from the scoop toward the bowl
A large clay crowd of tiny identical figures with a small circular platform lifted out of it holding just a few of them
A clay column of sorting slots, each holding clay tokens of a different shape and colour
A single clay token on a plinth beside a tall stack of identical tokens of the same shape
A clay figure at a fork in a path, holding a small chart board and looking toward one branch
A clay figure at a desk holding a magnifying glass over a page printed by a small clay machine beside it
A clay stamp pressing a mark onto a page, with a ring of clay arrows circling from the page back to the stamp
A clay server rack with a soft plume rising from its top, drifting over a small clay tree
A heap of broken clay phones, cables and circuit boards piled beside a small clay recycling bin
